sources.label: Wikipedia, "LHS 3844 b"
sources.quote: LHS 3844 b, formally named Kuaꞌkua, is an exoplanet orbiting the red dwarf star LHS 3844, about 48.5 light-years away in the constellation Indus.

introduction.text: It is the only planet known around LHS 3844. Its orbit and size follow Nagel et al. 2026's fit, the archive's default.
